    tidyinvasion: tidy tools for invasion biology

    Source: R/tidyinvasion-package.R
    tidyinvasion-package.Rd

    tidyinvasion covers the invasion process from introduction to impact. Functions are grouped by stage:

    Details

    • Classes: inv_occurrence(), inv_pathway() and the inv_spread tibble returned by inv_spread_rate().

    • Introduction: inv_propagule_pressure(), inv_establishment_prob(), inv_detection_prob().

    • Spread: inv_distance(), inv_spread_rate(), inv_dispersal_kernel(), inv_lag_phase().

    • Impact: inv_impact_metrics(), inv_parker_impact(), inv_homogenization(), inv_eicat_score().

    • Biosecurity: inv_eradication_feasibility(), inv_horizon_scan().

    • tidymodels: step_inv_background(), step_inv_propagule_lags(), step_inv_env_distance(), inv_spatial_block_cv(), inv_temporal_transfer_cv(), boyce_index(), tss(), inv_sdm(), inv_reaction_diffusion().

    Distances use the haversine formula for geographic coordinates and Euclidean distance for projected coordinates, and all likelihoods are maximised with stats::optim(), so no compiled spatial libraries are needed. sf point layers are accepted when the sf package is installed.
